title: Yummy Pillowy Norwegian Courgette Stew
description: A jammy, pillowy stew that showcases Norwegian flavors with al-dente courgettes and a fragrant, stone-bowl finish.
instructions: Wash and slice 400g courgettes into 1 cm cubes.
Peel and dice 150g onion into small cubes.
Peel and dice 200g carrots and 150g potato into similar sized cubes.
Heat 30ml olive oil in the dolsot over medium heat.
Add onions and garlic; sauté until onions turn translucent.
Add carrots, potato and courgettes; cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in 30g tomato paste, 15ml lemon juice, 3g dill and 960ml vegetable stock; bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes until vegetables are al dente.
Whisk 1 egg white until frothy, fold gently into the stew and let sit for 5 minutes to create a pillowy texture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then ladle into the preheated dolsot for serving.
